sections.title: Job Curses His Day
sections.summary: Job breaks his silence and wishes he had never been born.

sections.title: Eliphaz Speaks
sections.summary: The first friend urges Job to accept God's correction.

sections.title: Job Answers Eliphaz
sections.summary: Job protests that his friends have failed him and pleads with God.

sections.title: Bildad Speaks
sections.summary: The second friend insists that God never perverts justice.

sections.title: Who Can Argue with God?
sections.summary: Job longs for a fair hearing before God.

sections.title: Zophar Speaks
sections.summary: The third friend tells Job he deserves worse.

sections.title: Job: Man Born of Woman
sections.summary: Job answers all three and wonders whether a man can live again.

sections.title: Eliphaz Again
sections.summary: Eliphaz accuses Job of undermining reverence for God.

sections.title: Job: A Witness in Heaven
sections.summary: Job calls his friends miserable comforters and looks for a witness on high.

sections.title: Bildad Again
sections.summary: Bildad describes the fate of the wicked.

sections.title: Job's Redeemer
sections.summary: Abandoned by all, Job declares his hope in a redeemer.

sections.title: Zophar Again
sections.summary: Zophar insists the joy of the wicked is brief.

sections.title: Job: The Wicked Prosper
sections.summary: Job points out that the wicked often live long and well.

sections.title: Eliphaz's Last Speech
sections.summary: Eliphaz charges Job with hidden sins and urges him to return.

sections.title: If Only I Could Find Him
sections.summary: Job seeks God and lists the wrongs of the world.

sections.title: Bildad's Last Word; Job Replies
sections.summary: A short speech from Bildad and Job's answer on the greatness of God.

sections.title: Job's Oath; Where Wisdom Is Found
sections.summary: Job holds to his integrity; a poem on the hidden place of wisdom.

sections.title: Job's Final Defence
sections.summary: Job remembers his past, laments his present and swears his innocence.

sections.title: Elihu Speaks
sections.summary: A young bystander answers Job and the friends.

sections.title: Elihu on God's Justice
sections.summary: Elihu defends God's justice against Job's complaint.

sections.title: Elihu: God Is Great
sections.summary: Elihu ends with God's greatness in the storm.

sections.title: The Rest of God's First Speech
sections.summary: God continues with questions about light, weather and wild animals.

sections.title: God's Second Speech
sections.summary: God speaks of Behemoth and Leviathan, creatures beyond human mastery.
